CoreIDPath.description: String core instance identifier such as default-xray or experimental-sing-box.
CoreIDPath.name: id

EmbeddedClientIDPath.description: Matches settings.clients[].id, usually a UUID; this is not an inbound id.
EmbeddedClientIDPath.name: id

InboundScopeIDPath.description: Positive inbound id, or -1 for all inbounds.
InboundScopeIDPath.name: id

VersionPath.description: Stable Xray release tag from v26.10.10 onward; older versions are rejected by the installer.
VersionPath.name: version

sni.description: Required after trimming; must not start with '-' or contain whitespace or NUL.

db.description: .db, .sqlite, or .sqlite3 SQLite backup, 16 bytes to 64 MiB. The multipart request limit is 65 MiB. Candidate migration and real-core configuration validation must pass.

sni.description: Comma-separated DNS or IP SANs, at most 16 entries. Empty uses localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1.

allOutbounds.description: Optional serialized outbound array for dialerProxy resolution.

AuthNotFound.description: Unauthenticated /panel/api requests intentionally return 404 to hide API existence.

BinaryFile.description: Authenticated binary file download, or a legacy JSON error envelope if snapshot creation fails.

ForbiddenCSRF.description: CSRF validation failed for a state-changing request.

LegacyMsg.description: Legacy JSON response envelope used by web/entity.Msg.

AllSetting.description: Legacy panel settings payload mirrored by web/entity.AllSetting.

twoFactorToken.description: Always empty in settings responses. In update requests, empty preserves the existing secret; disabling clears it after old-code verification.

webBasePath.description: Normalized to leading/trailing slashes. Empty or root values become /super/.

subId.description: Enriched projection, not a persisted ClientTraffic column.

uuid.description: Enriched projection, not a persisted ClientTraffic column.

settings.description: Legacy JSON string stored on database/model.Inbound.

sniffing.description: Legacy JSON string stored on database/model.Inbound.

streamSettings.description: Legacy JSON string stored on database/model.Inbound.

trafficReset.description: Reset schedule, usually never, hourly, daily, weekly or monthly.

obj.description: Endpoint-specific payload. Existing clients unwrap this field.

TrafficUpdateRequest.description: Upload and download replace stored byte counters. Omitted values bind as zero and overwrite existing values.

twoFactorCode.description: Current 6-digit code, required when enabling, disabling or replacing an authenticator. New code on first enable; old code on disable or replacement. Never persisted.

cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Lax panel session cookie issued by POST /login.
cookieAuth.name: SuperXray

csrfToken.description: Session-bound CSRF token injected into the Vue runtime config; X-XSRF-Token is accepted as a compatibility alias.
csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token

info.description:
Machine-readable contract for the Vue panel API implemented by the local Go/Gin backend.
Runtime deployments may prepend the configured webBasePath before these paths.
The legacy response envelope is web/entity.Msg: success, msg, obj.
Business failures generally use HTTP 200 with success=false; callers must inspect the envelope.
Forwarded scheme and client IP are accepted only from SUPERXRAY_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS.
